reviewer: root source review; independent implementation by materials agent and separate physics peer
science: Derived electrode charge balance from the two-capacitor voltage clamp and the two-state marked-jump correlation. Source correctly computes left tunneling-current noise. External-wire current requires electrode charge redistribution. The full resolvent agrees with an independent closed scalar spectrum; charge continuity, high-frequency jump variance and independent voltage-response FDT checks verify physical normalization.
public_input_review: The two-state Markov approximation, electrostatic circuit, absence of third capacitance/impedance, voltage clamps, electrode location, units, sign convention and doubled two-sided PSD are explicit. Public task gives no current weighting correction or named theorem. Full implementation replacement permitted. All capacitance inputs already affect addition energy and rates. Private files excluded from public image.
calibration_review: 216 fixed-sigma zero-frequency readings agree for both current observables by bounded charge accumulation, identify the common positive rate linearly, and have matching public/private copies. All256 noise realizations pass both calibrations and oracle predictions and reject only the shortcut finite-frequency groups.
grading_review: Public ranges include every tested frequency, bias and capacitor ratio. Positive finite spectra, API, calibration and parameter checked; zero-frequency anchors agree. Tolerance .04 is well above fitting/numerical errors. No source/solver restrictions.
classification_caveat: Retaining tunneling-current readout is physical. Correct terminal-current derivation followed by sign/normalization/coding mistake is classified separately.
